reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows that Ru incorporation into a hollow high-entropy oxide modifies electronic structure and enhances NO adsorption and reduction, but it does not address durability under thermal aging, moisture, or transient exhaust conditions, nor does it demonstrate atomically dispersed Ru on an automotive alloy catalyst. The key premises about durability and stabilization against deactivation are unsupported.
premises: Ru incorporation modifies electronic structure of multi-element oxides
Ru promotes NO reduction reaction kinetics
Atomically dispersed Ru can be deposited on a multi-element surface
Electronic modification by Ru stabilizes active sites against deactivation
